{{Infobox place|name=The Hub|type=Seat of [[House Stormrider]]|region=Northern rim of [[the Ash Fields]], where the heartland opens into [[the Expanses]]|house=[[House Stormrider]]|notable=No wall, only roads; the Weaving-ground; the ash beneath}}
'''The Hub''' is a ring-shaped complex where all northern roads run in toward an open central field — no wall, only roads. Nothing is built over '''the Weaving-ground''': ''"what is united shall be seen by all."'' The Hub stands on the War of the Unification's battlefield; you find bones and ash when you dig. The house builds atop it deliberately.
